prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint exactly ONE original Turnip Works fantasy tabletop UI pictogram: Two separate blocks, one ochre and one teal, with two ivory exchange arrows above and below them pointing in opposite directions. No dice, no pips. Heroic hand-painted style D: chunky miniature-safe forms, broad soft bevels, matte painted gradients, restrained brushwork, no glossy plastic. Centered on a warm pale parchment circular ground, quiet thin antique brass rim; ivory shapes instead dark slate for strong contrast. Straight-on circular badge, subject fills 80 percent of the disc, outer disc fills 94 percent of square canvas. Light from upper left. Palette: warm ochre wood, muted teal, ivory, slate, red only for danger or pin. Must read at 31 pixels: extremely simple silhouette, thick features, generous negative space, no tiny detail. Transparent outside the circle, preserve actual alpha. No text, lettering, numbers, watermark, decorative flourishes, extra symbols, or scene. Text-only original design; no third-party references.
processing: Native alpha preserved; transparent square padding when needed; Lanczos resize; lossless WebP.
blind_prompt:

View it at its supplied size. What action does this button do?

interpretation and confidence (low/medium/high). If ambiguous, state why and one
plausible alternative. Do not assume any action from the filename. Be concise.
